{"data":{"id":"1192474","key":"RCS-20774","fields":{"summary":"Urban Outfitters - Cannot Download Secure Store Fields from Searchable as Excel Developer Mode Setting","description":"

Urban has a new admin user and he has requested a fields dictionary since he wants to better understand what each field represents in Secure. Typically when a user asks for this, I will use the Searchable as Excel in the Developer Mode settings and download the fields for Secure Store area since fields may have been renamed or hidden during implementation or after. When I try to do that for Urban, I get an error. I have attached a video showing the steps that I took. If someone could either get the Searchable as Excel to download correctly or provide me with the an excel of all Secure Store fields so that I can fulfil this request from Urban.

During the All Hands Demo, @Chris Rippingale mentioned that the Searchable as Excel was now in Control Panel, but what I’ve noticed (with Urban and TJX) is that when I download the Secure Store tables, the label doesn’t show the alias custom to that client.

Urban example - Trans Num is the alias in Secure, but when I use the Searchable as Excel, the labels shows the out of box Ticket No:

So if I were to try to add definitions for the fields, the excel isn’t showing the alias for the particular client I am viewing.
